_comment: The Millbeck bridge (B8, Stas 2026-11-05: the bridge as a fixed event, fitted to Faces of the Road): the Millbeck zone, the upper stretch of the river road, so the first leg from Wendford meets it once. Milestone 11 (MAP-10): every choice writes crossed_millbeck; the toll men are Col and Dunn; The Way Back meets The bridge again (MAP-14: its own deck now holds it, as an arrival card of the bridge). Our own text, CC-BY-4.0, credit 'nat20-table contributors'. Variant rule (D2): the road event deck is ours. The two toll men are SRD 5.2.1 Bandits. A variant replaces a choice, so every case keeps three.

cards.text: At the little bridge over the Millbeck a man in a torn sheepskin coat and a borrowed helmet holds out his cap, a notched tally stick in his other hand: the reeve's toll, he says, two silver a head. His brother leans on a cudgel by a willow hut, beside a cold fire and a heap of gnawed sheep bones.
cards.text_ru: У мостика через Миллбек человек в рваном тулупе и чужом шлеме протягивает шапку, в другой руке у него бирка с зарубками. Пошлина старосты, говорит он, по два серебряных с головы. Его брат опирается на дубину у шалаша из ивняка, рядом холодное кострище и куча обглоданных овечьих костей.

choices.text: Tell him the reeve charges no such toll.
choices.text_ru: Сказать ему, что староста такой пошлины не берёт.

choices.text: Tell them the reeve sent nobody, and that you know why they are here.
choices.text_ru: Сказать им, что староста никого не посылал и что вы знаете, зачем они здесь.

choices.text: Go upstream and ford the beck.
choices.text_ru: Подняться выше по течению и перейти ручей вброд.

choices.text: Offer them food for the road instead of a toll.
choices.text_ru: Предложить им еды в дорогу вместо пошлины.

cards.note: Col and Dunn, brothers from a Highsteads farm. The goblins took their flock this autumn; Rufus bought the farm's debt and set them on the bridge to slow Odda's wagon and pay him out of the toll. Osric, counting the common chest for the steward's yearly visit, had sent them away. Col counts every coin on a tally stick he cut himself, notch by notch, like a reeve. Torva's family lost a farm to debt: give her that line. In a fight the DM tells the brothers reaching for their cudgels; initiative is the engine's, and a brother who drops his cudgel has yielded. A scout who looks first sees the gnawed bones and the empty pot: these men are hungry, not hard.
